quote: Read all the books on Monte Cassino you like: but if you want to truly understand this battle you have to go there with Frank de Planta. Over four days, Frank brings to life the tactics, strategy and moving stories of the four battles. My wife – who has no interest in anything military – came home spellbound. There is no better, no more entertaining, and no more insightful guide than Frank de Planta.
name: Steve Deput
